title: Sheaf condition for the raw stage Kan-extension colimit
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category, $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories, and $V$ a cocone with vertex $C$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $P_j$ and $Q$ be precoverages on $F(j)$ and $C$. Every transition functor $F(a)$ and cocone functor $V_j$ is continuous for the generated topologies [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Fix $i\in J$ and a set-valued sheaf $G$ on $P_i$. Write $I=\mathrm{Under}(i)$, $A_t=F(t.hom)_sG$, and $H=V_{i,s}G$. For $b:t\to t'$ give a sheaf map $\theta_b:A_t\to F(b.right)^s A_{t'}$ whose composite with the unit $G\to F(t.hom)^s A_t$ equals the unit at $t'$ componentwise as objects of the arrow category of sets. For $t\in I$ let $B_t$ be a presheaf on $C$, with $\beta_t:A_t\to V_t^p B_t$ exhibiting $B_t$ as the left Kan extension of the underlying presheaf of $A_t$ along $V_t^{op}$. Here $V_t=V_{t.right}$, $V_t^p$ is presheaf restriction, and a left Kan extension means that composition with $\beta_t$ bijects maps $B_t\to T$ with maps $A_t\to V_t^p T$ for every presheaf $T$. Let $B:I\to\mathrm{PSh}(C)$ have these objects and satisfy, for all $b:t\to t'$ and $X\in F(t.right)$, $\beta_t(X)B(b)(V_tX)=\theta_b(X)\beta_{t'}(F(b.right)X)$ as objects of $\mathrm{Arrow}(\mathrm{Set})$.Assume also that the object and arrow cocones of $V$ are set colimits [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Every $P_j$ and $Q$ has singleton isomorphism covers, covering pullbacks, stability under finite composition and finite base change [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage]. Every covering presieve of $P_j$ has finitely many distinct arrows. Transitions preserve covering presieves and pullbacks along their covering arrows, and their inverse-image functors preserve finite limits. The $Q$-covers are exactly images of stage covering presieves transported along object equalities, and each $V_j$ preserves covering pullbacks.Then the actual presheaf colimit $\mathrm{colim}\,B$ satisfies the sheaf condition for $Q$ and its generated Grothendieck topology. No assertion is made about maps to the canonical inverse image or equality of its sections.

proof.text: The pointwise Kan formula and common-stage lifting of arrows describe evaluation of colimit B at Y as the filtered colimit over stage object presentations of Y of the sections of A_t. Common refinements and equality of lifts follow from the supplied object and arrow colimits; beta universality and the transition equation identify the induced maps with restrictions and theta.

proof.text: Lift a Q-cover to its finite stage cover and transport its finite arrows and covering pullbacks to a common stage. Preservation of covers and their pullbacks identifies its matching-family equalizer with the colimit of the corresponding stage equalizers. Each A_t is a sheaf. Filtered colimits commute with the finite products and equalizer, including the empty product, so the resulting presheaf satisfies the covering sheaf condition. Singleton isomorphisms and finite composition and base change extend this condition to the generated topology.
